headline: UPI now carries 88.7% of transactions
detail: In Mar 2025, UPI handled 88.7% of the volume across the seven payment methods in the dataset.

headline: UPI gained 4.9 points of volume share in two years
detail: Share rose from 83.8% to 88.7% (Apr 2023 to Mar 2025), taken mainly from IMPS (-2.5 pts) and Debit Card (-1.6 pts).

headline: UPI volume grew 106% over the period
detail: Monthly UPI transactions grew from 8,863 mn to 18,302 mn, a compound annual rate of 46.0%.
metric_label: UPI volume growth over the period (%)

headline: Volume dominance is not value dominance
detail: UPI averaged 9.2% of value in FY2024-25 (8.3% in FY2023-24), while RTGS carried 71% of value on average.

headline: Growth is maturing while tickets shrink
detail: UPI year-on-year volume growth slowed from 50.1% to 36.2%, and the average ticket fell 15.2% (INR 1,597 to INR 1,354).
